gfp2026.title: Global Firepower 2026 Military Strength Ranking (145 countries)
gfp2026.license: GFP content is (c) GlobalFirePower.com; the scrape repository states no license. Factual counts with attribution; confirm terms before commercial release.
notes: Equipment counts are total inventory and can include equipment in storage or of doubtful serviceability.
Aircraft sub-categories overlap (e.g. multirole jets counted as fighter and attack); never sum them.
Naval tonnage of 0 means not reported, not zero tonnage.
Power index values were cross-checked against published 2026 rankings (US 0.0741, Russia 0.0791, China 0.0919).

gfp2022.title: Global Firepower 2022 Military Strength Ranking (140 countries)
notes: Used for the 2021 snapshot: it is the last edition compiled before the February 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
The 'Fighters/Interceptors' column is corrupted in this copy (identical to total aircraft for every country) and is discarded.
Afghanistan already reflects the August 2021 collapse of the Afghan National Army.

vdem_v16.title: V-Dem Country-Year Dataset v16
vdem_v16.publisher: Varieties of Democracy Institute, University of Gothenburg
vdem_v16.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (cite Coppedge et al., V-Dem Dataset v16)
notes: Year 2020 is used for the 2021 snapshot and 2025 for the 2026 snapshot (state of the country at scenario start).

sipri_milex.title: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
sipri_milex.license: SIPRI data free to use with attribution; OWID packaging CC BY 4.0
notes: Market-exchange-rate figures. Systematically lower than Global Firepower's budget estimates for Russia and China.

sipri_yb2021.title: SIPRI Yearbook 2021, chapter 10: World nuclear forces (January 2021)
notes: Global total 13,080 warheads, 3,825 deployed.
US: 1,800 deployed, 2,000 stored, 5,550 total. Russia: 1,625 deployed, 2,870 stored, 6,255 total (Table 10.1).

sipri_yb2026.title: SIPRI Yearbook 2026, chapter 8: World nuclear forces (January 2026)
notes: Global inventory 12,187; military stockpiles 9,745; deployed 4,012.
US 1,770 deployed + 1,930 stored. Russia 1,796 deployed + 2,604 stored (+1,020 retired, 5,420 total).
China ~620, India ~190 (12 deployed, first time), Pakistan ~170, North Korea possibly ~60 assembled.
Per-country stockpiles in data/curated/nuclear.json sum exactly to the published 9,745.

gallup_eoy2023.title: Gallup International Association, End of Year Survey 2023: 'If there were a war that involved [your country], would you be willing to fight for your country?'
notes: The primary PDF was not reachable from the build environment; values were collected from press coverage of the release. Per-country confidence is recorded in data/curated/willingness_to_fight.json.
Used for both snapshots: no comparable all-country survey exists for 2021 (WVS wave 7 is per-country microdata).

curated_bmd.title: Ballistic missile defence deployments (curated)
curated_bmd.publisher: Compiled for this project from official announcements and press reporting; each entry cites its source
notes: Interception probabilities are model estimates informed by published test records, not measured combat performance.
Battery and interceptor counts are estimates where governments do not publish them.

curated_doctrine.title: Nuclear doctrine and delivery characterisation (curated)
curated_doctrine.publisher: Compiled for this project from national declaratory policy
notes: Mapping real doctrines onto four engine doctrine types is a judgement call; rationale per state in data/curated/nuclear.json.

model.title: Derived by the WARGAME loader
notes: Values computed from sourced inputs by documented formulas (e.g. stability from V-Dem state-capacity indicators, equipment quality from spending per soldier).

curated_alliances.title: Defensive pacts and geopolitical alignment (curated)
curated_alliances.publisher: Compiled for this project; pacts from treaty texts, relations as documented judgement
notes: Pact membership is factual. Relation strengths are curated judgements on a -1..1 scale; each listed pair can be challenged and tuned.

gfp2025.title: Global Firepower 2025 Military Strength Ranking (145 countries)
gfp2025.via: User-supplied CSV global_military_firepower_2025.csv (sha256 9e4748da36caad04f8c4e9409ef1fee59379e5bf03d367eab3f443a5d5d1a763), vendored as data/raw/gfp_2025.csv
notes: Identified as the 2025 edition: its rank order (UK 6, France 7, Japan 8, Turkiye 9, Italy 10) matches the published 2025 ranking and differs from 2026 (France 6, Japan 7, UK 8).

Used to (a) cross-check the 2026 edition one year apart, (b) fill values missing from the 2026 scrape, (c) replace 2026 budgets that contradict SIPRI while the 2025 value does not, (d) supply regions for every country.

override.title: Manual corrections (data/curated/overrides.json)
override.publisher: This project; each override carries its own citation
notes: Applied last. Use to correct any value with a better source.

natural_earth.title: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural and physical vectors v5.1.2
notes: Admin-1 provinces, populated places (city populations, capitals), ports, airports, physical geography regions (terrain).
Natural Earth assigns Crimea to Russia (de facto); corrected to Ukrainian ownership with Russian control in data/curated/map_control.json.

gppd.title: Global Power Plant Database v1.3
notes: ~35,000 plants with location and capacity (data to ~2020). Drives ENERGY tags and part of the industrial distribution.

deepstate.title: DeepStateMap.Live occupied territory of Ukraine, 1 January 2026
deepstate.license: Archive repository is GPL-3.0; DeepStateMap's own terms apply to the underlying map. Confirm before commercial release.
notes: Occupied area 116,219 km2 (~19% of Ukraine), consistent with public reporting. Splits Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson and Kharkiv along the real front.

curated_control.title: De jure ownership, de facto control, naval bases (curated)
curated_control.publisher: Compiled for this project; each entry states its basis
notes: The 2015-2022 Donbas line of contact is approximated from front-line settlements (+/- ~10 km).

curated_fortifications.title: Fortified lines at each start date (curated)
curated_fortifications.publisher: Compiled for this project; each entry states its basis
notes: Fortification levels (0..0.6) are judgement on the scale of QJM defensive postures.

curated_force_posture.title: Wartime force posture: drones, mobilisation, basing, equipment in storage (curated)
curated_force_posture.publisher: Compiled for this project from IISS Military Balance figures as reported, official statements and press; each entry cites its source
notes: Active shares apply the tank figure to all land equipment, an approximation.
Drone saturation is a 0..1 judgement anchored on production figures.

curated_leadership.title: Leadership defiance (curated)
curated_leadership.publisher: Compiled for this project from documented wartime conduct
notes: Only leaders with documented wartime conduct are listed; all others default to 0.
